name: Neon
source:
Doctor Neon is a brilliant but socially isolated scientist.
She is obsessed with finding “silence” and signals from deep space, which she considers to be the only truth in a world full of “noise.”
After being betrayed by a colleague and forced to flee the laboratory, she finds herself drawn into a world where physics borders on mysticism.

She searches for her lost friend, Celestia, believing that only she can restore harmony to her life. Neon is not good at communicating with people and often finds herself in awkward situations, but her analytical mind is her main weapon.
